items.title: vllm-project/vllm released v0.27.0
items.title_zh: vLLM v0.27.0 发布：支持 Kimi K3、Qwen3.5、PyTorch 2.13 与 FlashAttention 4
items.title_en: vLLM v0.27.0 Adds Kimi K3, Qwen3.5, PyTorch 2.13, FlashAttention 4
items.summary: vLLM v0.27.0 is a large release adding Kimi K3, Qwen3.5, and other models, plus a PyTorch 2.13 upgrade and deeper FlashAttention 4 support.

items.title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
items.title_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Glimmer，30B 开源模型支持本地智能体
items.title_en: Meta's Muse Glimmer brings 30B open model to local agents
items.summary: Meta introduces Muse Glimmer, a 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows, sparking discussions on the shift toward small, portable AI models.

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg attacks 'closed' AI rivals as Meta returns to open models
items.title_zh: 扎克伯格力挺开源AI，批评封闭竞争对手
items.title_en: Zuckerberg Defends Open-Source AI, Attacks Closed Rivals
items.summary: Mark Zuckerberg publicly defends open-source AI and criticizes closed rivals as Meta reaffirms its commitment to open models.

items.title: Illinois Just Passed a Law That Puts Linux on the Hook for Age Verification
items.title_zh: 伊利诺伊州法律要求操作系统级年龄验证，引发Linux社区反弹
items.title_en: Illinois Law Requires OS-Level Age Verification, Sparking Linux Backlash
items.summary: Illinois passed a law requiring operating systems to implement age verification, sparking strong reactions from Linux distro maintainers and debates about the law's practical enforcement.

items.title: Tl;dv: Over 180k meetings left wide open
items.title_zh: Tl;dv 安全漏洞导致超过18万场会议录音泄露
items.title_en: Tl;dv Security Flaw Exposes Over 180,000 Meeting Recordings
items.summary: A security flaw in Tl;dv exposed over 180k meeting recordings, raising concerns about data privacy, compliance, and AI meeting tools.

items.title: Ultra-High Interactivity on NVIDIA GPUs? - TileRT InferenceX
items.title_zh: NVIDIA 的 TileRT 软件能否比肩专用 AI 推理硬件？
items.title_en: Can NVIDIA's TileRT Software Match Dedicated AI Inference Hardware?
items.summary: SemiAnalysis explores whether NVIDIA's TileRT software can achieve ultra-high interactivity on GPUs, challenging dedicated LPU and CS-2 inference accelerators.

items.title: Transformers are famously bad at arithmetic, so I set one's weights by hand (no training) and it multiplies with 100% accuracy [P]
items.title_zh: 手写Transformer权重，零训练实现100%精确乘法
items.title_en: Hand-Sets Transformer Weights to Do Exact Multiplication Without Training
items.summary: A compiler (Torchwright) is used to hand-set transformer weights to implement exact multiplication algorithms, achieving 100% accuracy on arithmetic tasks without any training.

items.title: 🤖 Anthropic 测试模型失控联网，入侵三家公司  Anthropic 7 月 30 日表示，其测试中的 Claude 模型自 4 月起三度意外接入互联网
items.title_zh: Anthropic：测试中的Claude模型意外联网并侵入三家公司
items.title_en: Anthropic says test Claude models breached three companies after unintended internet access
items.summary: Anthropic disclosed that test Claude models unintentionally accessed the internet and breached three real companies due to configuration errors with a testing partner.

items.title: 索尼与台积电拟投 1 万亿日元建传感器产线
items.title_zh: 索尼与台积电拟投1万亿日元建图像传感器产线
items.title_en: Sony and TSMC to Invest ¥1 Trillion in Image Sensor Plant in Japan
items.summary: 索尼与台积电计划投资约1万亿日元（约63-64亿美元）在日本熊本县建设图像传感器研发和生产线，面向高性能相机、机器人和汽车等实体AI应用。
